noaa_ngdc_3day_forecast.purpose: Kp and daily NOAA R/S forecast probabilities

channels.description: Planetary Kp forecast in three-hour UTC bins; distinct from local k.
Daily probability of S1 or greater; not an event or hourly probability.
Daily probability of R1-R2 radio blackouts.
Daily probability of R3 or greater radio blackouts.

noaa_ngdc_3day_forecast.fallback_policy: Use previously issued still-valid bulletin; daypre supplements its own channels only, never substitutes Kp.

noaa_ngdc_daypre.purpose: Daily and three-hour forecast channels, distinct from observations

channels.description: Predicted station/middle-latitude k index, NOT planetary Kp.
Predicted high-latitude k index, NOT planetary Kp.
Daily probability of middle-latitude active conditions.
Daily probability of middle-latitude minor storm conditions.
Daily probability of middle-latitude major/severe storm conditions.
Daily probability of high-latitude active conditions.
Daily probability of high-latitude minor storm conditions.
Daily probability of high-latitude major/severe storm conditions.
Daily 10.7 cm solar radio flux; 1 sfu = 1e-22 W m^-2 Hz^-1.
Daily whole-disk proton-event probability; NOT a timed event or a six-hour probability.

noaa_ngdc_daypre.fallback_policy: Use previously issued still-valid daypre. The 3day product supplies only semantically matching explicitly mapped channels; otherwise retain a gap.

nasa_jsc_oem.purpose: Historical reconstruction of ISS position/velocity in EME2000 UTC
nasa_jsc_oem.fallback_policy: Use another OEM only inside its declared usable interval; keep each segment provenance. No extrapolation and no silent admission into strict replay.

nasa_donki_notification.purpose: Dated research notifications pending physical scope/validity audit
nasa_donki_notification.fallback_policy: Use retained exact response snapshot; absence of messages is not a physical all-clear. Mutable parent event cards cannot fill missing historical revisions.

schema_notes: Independent A1 data schema, not a replacement for vkd/types.py or final consumer API.
Source map -> raw_record_id -> zero-based index in records_path records array. Full metadata is in that record.
All paths are repository-relative. Null means unknown, never zero or available.
version is a SHA-256 content snapshot, not a proved provider version at historical cutoff.
available_utc for dated bulletins/notifications is provider issue-time evidence, not an independent contemporaneous capture. Check eligibility and limitations.
NOAA validity endpoints are exclusive; OEM uses coverage_end_inclusive=true.
No global coverage boolean: evaluate source, channel, issue cutoff, validity and scenario separately.
